solutions.latex:

$3n^2 - 6n > 600$, so $n^2 - 2n - 200 > 0$.

Let $n^2 - 2n - 200 = 0$: $n = \dfrac{2 \pm \sqrt{4 + 800}}{2}$, so $n = 15.18\ldots$ or $n = -13.18\ldots$

$n > 15.18\ldots$ or $n < -13.18\ldots$ (not possible as $n > 0$).

$S = \dfrac{a}{1 - r} = \dfrac{1}{1 - (1 - \sqrt{e})} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{e}}$

$\log 4 + \log 16 + \log 64 + \cdots + \log 16384$

$= \log 2^2 + \log 2^4 + \log 2^6 + \cdots + \log 2^{14}$

$= 2\log 2 + 4\log 2 + \cdots + 14\log 2$

$= \log 2\left[2 + 4 + \cdots + 14\right]$

With $a = 2$, $n = 7$, $l = 14$: $S_n = \dfrac{n}{2}(a + l)$, so

$= \log 2\left[\dfrac{7}{2}(2 + 14)\right] = 56\log 2$

So $a = 56$, $b = 2$.
